annotations.text:
M1-M3 screens: everything needed to run one session from a phone.

One hue per theme type carries the whole system: Self red, Mythos purple, Noise cyan. Positive mint, negative amber, burnt a bright neutral. Nothing else is coloured, so a tag's origin is readable at a glance. Magenta is reserved for the app's own primary action.

No effect picker, and nothing to save. One action can influence and weaken at once, so the builder just totals an action; effects get chosen afterwards, when Power is spent, and the roll is thrown away once made.

Power is always shown as a breakdown, never a bare number. traced-1 sits selected but struck through: only the highest tier on each side counts, and the app says so instead of silently dropping it.
Compute and warn, never block. The loadout sits 1P over budget and the app says so in plain words. The desktop readiness check reads the same way.
Reference shows the content pack with its rules text empty: the effect names ship, the cost and rule slots stay visibly blank until filled.
